from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess, sys
site = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
candidates = sorted(site.rglob('verify_example.py'))
report = {'scope': 'Offline catalogue worked example and fixture discovery', 'inventory': [str(p.relative_to(site)) for p in sorted(site.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()], 'runs': []}
for entry in candidates:
    run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(entry.relative_to(site))], cwd=site, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    report['runs'].append({'entrypoint': str(entry.relative_to(site)), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(entry.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'exit': run.returncode, 'stdout': run.stdout, 'stderr': run.stderr, 'fixture_setup': entry.read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
report['limits'] = 'This run checks the existing worked example. Separate execution is required for the reordered and swapped barcode fixtures. No live import or customer activity is measured.'
output = Path('products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue/delivery-rehearsal/documented-entrypoint.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False))
